stage.name: Mineshaft Crawl
stage.description:
Ancient ore deposits interlinked with one another were once witnesses to Arsalan's prosperity, but are now also the silent bearers of today's turmoil. 
No melee/ranged deployment restrictions in this Operation
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

startled_vesperwing.name: Startled Vesperwing
startled_vesperwing.flavourText: A startled Vesperwing will attack intruders who enter its territory at any cost. Their claws and fangs are sharp, and they are both ferocious and impatient. But in their eyes, they're simply protecting their homeland.
abilities: Aerial unit, prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Deals Arts damage
Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

tiacauh_impaler_adept.name: Tiacauh Impaler Adept
tiacauh_impaler_adept.flavourText: Warriors who have gained greater proficiency in using thrown weapons due to training, and boast greater lethality. However, due to the weight of their weapons, their range hasn't really improved.

tiacauh_ripper.name: Tiacauh Ripper
tiacauh_ripper.flavourText: An extremely fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Each strike now deals noteworthy damage, and those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

vein_guardian.name: Vein Guardian
vein_guardian.flavourText: A deformed Infected Creature often found wandering around ore veins, stubbornly thinking they have a duty to guard the mine.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts a certain amount of Arts damage to the attacker

z_mr_tr_yas_acolyte.name: Zümrütrüyası Acolyte
z_mr_tr_yas_acolyte.flavourText: An acolyte whose charm reflects her power. The more delicate her flowers, the swifter her blade.
abilities: When unblocked, damage taken is reduced by 50%

lord_ameer_shaman.name: Lord Ameer Shaman
lord_ameer_shaman.flavourText: An elite caster under a Lord Ameer, able to employ a kind of ancient Arts to cast menacing attacks, nicknamed a 'curse' by the locals.
abilities: Attacks cause the target to receive a certain amount of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over a few seconds (stacks)

crystalline_cragpincer.name: Crystalline Cragpincer
crystalline_cragpincer.flavourText: A Cragpincer with crystals on its shell, not only eye-catching but also extremely beautiful. However, it is also harder to handle. The completely crystallized carapace is a popular ornament once properly processed. It is said that some people also keep these as ornamental pets.
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

lush_mossback_beast.name: Lush Mossback Beast
lush_mossback_beast.flavourText: A beast with moss all over its body, easily agitated compared to others of its kind because of tiny, hard-to-remove bugs hiding in its vegetation. The moss grows back extremely quickly, and it will sometimes eat some even when uninjured.
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

pyric_originium_slug.name: Pyric Originium Slug
pyric_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.
abilities: Attacks deal Burn

maddened_vein_guardian.name: Maddened Vein Guardian
maddened_vein_guardian.flavourText: A deformed Infected Creature often found wandering around ore veins. Guarding the mines has become an obsession of theirs, and they are willing to die for it.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; when attacked, inflicts a certain amount of Arts damage to the attacker

mine_drudge.name: Mine Drudge
mine_drudge.flavourText: A familiar sight in mine shafts for millennia. Laborers have always propped up the pinnacles of civilization with their rugged hands, but found their own feet mired in the mud of the label 'uncivilized.'
abilities: Deals more damage when attacking resources

keratex_clawbeast.name: Keratex Clawbeast
keratex_clawbeast.flavourText: A Chitotex Clawbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Their sturdy upper limbs accelerate their excavation of rock exponentially, while their stern shells can shrug off severe batterings. These traits allow them to better expand their territory.
abilities: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is significantly decreased

tiacauh_champion.name: Tiacauh Champion
tiacauh_champion.flavourText: An incredibly formidable Tiacauh warrior, with the qualifications to become a Warchief. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

raging_direswine.name: Raging Direswine
raging_direswine.flavourText: A variety of Direswine extremely easy to anger, they dominate areas near water sources with great swagger. If one is enraged, it will indiscriminately rampage about with a madness sufficient to lay anything in the vicinity low.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Gradually accelerates when charging, dealing damage based on Movement Speed to any target it passes through or is blocked by

imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.
abilities: Flying unit.

mudrock_colossus.name: Mudrock Colossus
mudrock_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, does not possess sentience and must be directly controlled by Mudrock. Though bulky and slow, they are extremely durable and boast terrifying physical damage and survivability.

sarkaz_caster.name: Sarkaz Caster
sarkaz_caster.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

consortium_of_pincers.name: 'Consortium of Pincers'
consortium_of_pincers.flavourText: A Cragpincer with a gigantic crystallized shell, its back broad enough to carry two average-sized cragpincers. If it can withstand the weight of two cragpincers and the crystals on its back, who knows how strong it actually is, so do be careful of its pincers!
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

dublinn_evocator_leader.name: Dublinn Evocator Leader
dublinn_evocator_leader.flavourText: An evocation caster leader in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs, they are more adept at using Originium Arts than their underlings. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.
abilities: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and Burn; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

kouaku_cautelotaur.name: Kouaku Cautelotaur
kouaku_cautelotaur.flavourText: A cunning and ruthless variety of Cautelotaur, it conceals itself in herds to launch surprise attacks, the prey it catches subjected to its capricious whims. Most hunters that attempt to hunt this creature return with nothing to show for it.
abilities: After feeding on a <Chitotex Clawbeast> or <Keratex Clawbeast>, keeps its shell to use as a defensive tool, significantly lowering all damage except to the rear

hexed_colossus.name: Hexed Colossus
hexed_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, has been entwined with ancient Sarkaz witchcraft and now serves as an extension of its owner's will. The principle behind this Originium Art is quite obscure, but these constructs undoubtedly boast greater survivability and destructive power than normal Colossi.

pompeii.name: 'Pompeii'
pompeii.flavourText: A massive infected beast. These aberrations were born in a special high-temperature environment. Nobody wants to approach these creatures due to their grotesque appearance and the extreme heat they give off. The existence of these giant creatures has been known since ancient times, but to see one warped by infection is terrifyingly unforgettable...
abilities: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half
